title: Chatham Station

services.name: Chatham Station
services.desc: Nestled in the heart of charming Cary, Chatham Station is a stunning space setting the stage for forever. With beaming natural light shining through the garage bay doors, elegant finishes accenting the exposed brick wall, and thoughtful touches all around, you can expect your wedding day to be beautiful and full of fun (and have amazing pictures!). Skylight and seven garage bay doors from floor to ceiling providing stunning natural light Beautiful exposed brick and white exposed ceiling with modern light fixtures for an elevated environment Huge private patio with plants and market lights creating the perfect exterior

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Located in historic downtown Cary, Chatham Station is one of the Triangle’s premier wedding and event venues. Featuring 4,500 square feet of open space filled with rich character, thoughtful design, and an entire wall of natural light, Chatham Station is a special backdrop for your next gathering. We invite you to step in and imagine - to dream - of how you might paint your perfect day with us.
